articles.headline: Gabon government suspends national team, axe Aubameyang over AFCON calamity
articles.description: Gabon's government have come down hard on the country's national team following their shambolic performance at the Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON).

articles.headline: Super Eagles captain Victor Osimhen vows to 'trample on any team' Nigeria face in AFCON knockouts
articles.description: Victor Osimhen has sent a bold message to Nigeria's Africa Cup of Nations rivals, saying the Super Eagles can 'trample on any team' in their quest to end the country's 13-year wait for continental glory.

articles.headline: Nigeria wait on Ryan Alebiosu, Cyriel Dessers fitness for AFCON R16 clash against Mozambique
articles.description: Ryan Alebiosu's impressive Nigeria debut ended with the Blackburn Rovers defender being taken to the hospital after suffering a deep gash to his right foot in Tuesday's 3-1 victory over Uganda.

articles.headline: Defending champs Ivory Coast rally to win AFCON group
articles.description: Defending Africa Cup of Nations champions Ivory Coast came from two goals down to defeat Gabon 3-2 in their final Group F fixture in Marrakesh on Wednesday, qualifying them as group winners to set up a round of 16 showdown with Burkina Faso.
